messages.content: Calculate the cell density in a sample with an optical density of 0.6, where the experiment dilution is 5 times.

function.name: calculate_cell_density
function.description: Calculate the cell density of a biological sample based on its optical density and the experiment dilution.

optical_density.description: The optical density of the sample, usually obtained from a spectrophotometer reading. This is a float type value.

dilution.description: The dilution factor applied during the experiment.

calibration_factor.description: The calibration factor to adjust the density, default value is 1e9 assuming cell density is in CFU/mL. This is a float type value.

So we can call the function with these values. We don't need to specify calibration_factor unless we want to override the default. The description says default is 1e9, so we can omit it.
